name: Zero absorbs the star
summary: The zero scalar (a Z-spider plugged into an arity-1 H-box) absorbs a star.
description:
The phase-free ZH-calculus has only H-boxes labelled $-1$; to write the normalisation factors of the grey spider and the NOT it adds a scalar generator, the *star* $\star$, interpreted as $\frac{1}{\sqrt 2}$. A Z-spider plugged into an arity-1 H-box is $1 + (-1) = 0$, and rule (Z) says that this zero scalar absorbs a star. It is the only rule that changes the parity of the number of stars, so it is needed for completeness.

With scalars written as numbers both sides are $0$, so the rule is trivial.
unchecked_reason: uses the star generator (the scalar 1/√2), which PyZX cannot represent
